theorems.name: Submission.smr_ufd_integral_lower_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (g : Eucl P → ℝ) (A C S : Set (Eucl P)) (c : ℝ≥0∞), MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet C → MeasurableSet S → C ⊆ A → μ S < ∞ → Measurable g → (∀ x, |g x| ≤ 1) → (∀ x ∈ C, g x = 1) → (∀ x, x ∉ S → g x = 0) → c + μ (S \ C) < μ C → c < ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x in A, g x ∂μ)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
